snippet.description:
How do toppers actually improve their UPSC Mains answer writing?

In this video, Santosh Sir explains the answer writing cycle that helped aspirants like AIR 3 Archit Dongre improve their Mains preparation.

The process is simple: Study a topic → Analyse its PYQs → Write an answer → Get it evaluated → Identify your gaps → Improve.

Because every aspirant has different weaknesses, personalised feedback is crucial to developing better answers.

Don’t just read. Write, get evaluated and improve.

#upsc  #upscmains  #upscanswerwriting  #upsc2027  #upscpreparation  #upscstrategy  #levelupias  #MMP #MainsMasterProgram #upsctoppers
